additions.name: Kapahulu Market
additions.note: The Honolulu Zoo unveiled Kapahulu Market, its new food and beverage facility, in late August 2022, replacing the zoo's original 1951 concession.

fields.note: A 750-seat theater on the fourth floor of Royal Hawaiian Center, opened around July 2008 as Level 4 for the Waikiki Nei show. Today it is the Royal Hawaiian Theater, home of the Rock-A-Hula show.
Opened at Royal Hawaiian Center in March 2008. It reopened in September 2021 after a major renovation.
